verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a silicon chip, not software or a service. Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a property of the operating system or apps running on it, so this privacy-settings axis does not fit the product type. None of the evidence shows the chip itself collecting or offering control over telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
